name: siftmail-root
description: AI Smart Email Sorter Web Application Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently -n "server,client" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
